title: schedonorus arundinaceus var. aristatus
intro: Schedonorus arundinaceus var. aristatus, commonly known as aristate cock's foot, is a perennial grass species. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of aristate cock's foot are attributed to its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
